title: Dynamic UI & Data Binding
description: Bind live variables to HUD text, animate fill bars, and spawn data-bound inventory grids.

blocks.content: Dynamic UI and data binding keep HUD labels, health bars, and inventory grids synchronized with live gameplay variables and collections.

items.title: Live Text Interpolation
items.desc: Bind component variables or global state tokens directly into text labels without manual string concatenation.

items.title: Animated Fill Bars
items.desc: Smoothly tween health, mana, and experience bars across horizontal or vertical fill directions.

items.title: Prefab Grid Spawning
items.desc: Instantiate rows and columns of item slots from a prefab and bind each slot's child elements to an array of data.

blocks.content: Set up the following components and assets before binding gameplay data to your HUD or inventory screen.

rows: [Text Renderer](components/renderers/text_renderer)
HUD Labels & Slot Captions
Displays formatted strings, score counters, and interpolated variable tokens.
[Sprite Renderer](components/renderers/sprite_renderer)
Health Bars & Item Icons
Renders cropped fill bars and dynamically swapped item textures inside spawned UI slots.
[Variables & Collections](visual_scripting/variables_and_collections)
Logic Graph or Global State
Stores player stats, scores, and inventory item maps read by UI binding nodes.
[Entities & Prefabs](components/entities_and_prefabs)
Slot Prefab
Provides the reusable UI slot prefab instantiated by [UI Grid Spawner](node_library/helper_tool#node-uiGridSpawner).

blocks.content: Follow these steps to bind a live text counter, animate a health bar, and populate a data-driven inventory grid.

items: Select your HUD label entity, inspect its [Text Renderer](components/renderers/text_renderer) component in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), set **Bind Variable** to your score variable, and set **Bind Format** to **Score: {value}**.

To format multiple variables in a graph, pass a template string such as **HP: {hp}/{maxHp}** into [Format String](node_library/system_utilities#node-stringFormat) and connect **Result** to [Set Text](node_library/game_renderer#node-setText).
Create a health bar entity with a [Sprite Renderer](components/renderers/sprite_renderer) component placed over a background frame sprite on your UI layer.

When the player's health changes, divide current health by max health, multiply by **100**, and pass the percentage into [Fill Amount](node_library/game_animation#node-tweenFillAmount) targeting the health bar sprite.

To build an inventory grid, design a single slot entity with child entities named **Icon** (**Sprite Renderer**) and **Count** (**Text Renderer**), then save the slot as a reusable [Prefab](components/entities_and_prefabs).
In your UI graph, wire [UI Grid Spawner](node_library/helper_tool#node-uiGridSpawner), set **Prefab Name** to your slot prefab, and connect your inventory list to **Data List**.

Connect **On Spawn Item** from **UI Grid Spawner** to [UI Prefab Data Binder](node_library/helper_tool#node-uiPrefabBinder), linking **Spawned Entity**, **Item Data**, and **Item Index** so each slot populates its own icon and count.

blocks.content: Configure these parameters on [Fill Amount](node_library/game_animation#node-tweenFillAmount), [UI Grid Spawner](node_library/helper_tool#node-uiGridSpawner), and [UI Prefab Data Binder](node_library/helper_tool#node-uiPrefabBinder) to control layout and binding.

rows: **Fill %**
Target visible percentage of the sprite cropped along the chosen **Direction** (**left_to_right**, **right_to_left**, **top_to_bottom**, or **bottom_to_top**).
**Duration (Fill Amount)**
Time in seconds used to smoothly animate the bar from its previous fill percentage to the new value.
**Total Count & Columns**
Determines the total number of grid cells spawned and how many cells fit in each horizontal row before wrapping.
**Spacing X & Spacing Y**
Horizontal and vertical pixel distance between the centers of adjacent spawned grid cells.
**Bindings (Data Binder)**
Child-to-property map
Maps each child entity name (or **$self**) to a target property (**text**, **sprite**, **color**, **alpha**, **visible**) and data key.

blocks.content: Extend dynamic UI binding for modular HUD overlays, conditional slot highlighting, and batch property updates.

rows: **Reusable HUD Layer Injection**
Design your HUD or pause menu in a dedicated UI scene and load it into any gameplay level at runtime with [Inject Layer](node_library/game_lifecycle#node-injectLayer).
**Formatted Timers & Currency**

Use [String Format](node_library/system_utilities#node-stringFormat) with **{0}** and **{1}** placeholders to assemble multi-part strings before calling [Set Text](node_library/game_renderer#node-setText).
**Batch Theme or Opacity Updates**

Pass the **Spawned Entities** array from [UI Grid Spawner](node_library/helper_tool#node-uiGridSpawner) into [Batch Set Properties](node_library/game_renderer#node-batchSet) to fade or tint every grid slot at once.
[Fill Amount](node_library/game_animation#node-tweenFillAmount) stretches or shifts the bar instead of cropping it
Ensure the target entity uses a [Sprite Renderer](components/renderers/sprite_renderer) component with a loaded texture rather than a basic [Shape Renderer](components/renderers/shape_renderer).
[UI Prefab Data Binder](node_library/helper_tool#node-uiPrefabBinder) outputs a bound count of zero
Verify that the child entity names in the **Bindings** map match the exact child names inside the spawned prefab hierarchy.
Spawned grid items appear behind the inventory background panel
Set **Layer ID** on [UI Grid Spawner](node_library/helper_tool#node-uiGridSpawner) to your UI layer or assign the panel container as **Parent Entity**.
[Format String](node_library/system_utilities#node-stringFormat) leaves **{token}** unchanged in the text
Confirm that the variable name inside the curly braces exists in either the connected **Custom Map** input, port inputs, or global state.
